title: Establish extensible stats query and report architecture
description: Refactor internal/stats to support focused categorical and rolling time-series queries without destabilizing the existing overview contract. Introduce AttributeStatus, typed series metrics for created and progressed, rolling-range and time-bucket types, and a JSON report containing attribute, totalTasks, exact range boundaries, and buckets. Separate common task aggregation from overview-only handoff aggregation so later focused paths can avoid ListHandoffs. Preserve all existing Report and FocusedReport JSON fields and ordering. Establish an API that accepts an explicit asOf instant for deterministic tests. Do not alter provider interfaces, storage, CLI parsing, or rendering. Add contract tests, run go test ./internal/stats ./internal/cli, and keep all existing behavior green.
